name: Report Generator
description: Generates system reports by aggregating data from the Confidence Engine, Budget Manager, and Audit Log. Three-layer architecture: (1) Data Source Protocols for read-only dependency injection, (2) Frozen Pydantic v2 report data models composed into a top-level SystemReport, (3) Formatting/Delivery with ReportFormatter Protocol implementations and async WebhookDelivery. Reports are generated on-demand (CLI or library call), never in background. Provides visibility into system behavior without affecting it.

fields.name: task_type

functions.name: generate_report
functions.description: Generates a complete SystemReport by reading data from all three data sources (ConfidenceDataSource, BudgetDataSource, AuditDataSource). This is a synchronous, pure aggregation step with no side effects beyond reading from injected data sources. Triggered on-demand by CLI or library call.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Report configuration controlling correlation window count, alert lookback, etc. Validated at startup from YAML.

error_cases.name: confidence_source_unavailable
error_cases.condition: The injected ConfidenceDataSource raises an exception or is unreachable when queried.

error_cases.name: budget_source_unavailable
error_cases.condition: The injected BudgetDataSource raises an exception or is unreachable when queried.

error_cases.name: audit_source_unavailable
error_cases.condition: The injected AuditDataSource raises an exception or is unreachable when queried.

error_cases.name: no_task_types_found
error_cases.condition: The ConfidenceDataSource returns an empty list of task types, meaning no data exists to report on.

error_data.detail: No task types registered in the system. Report generation requires at least one task type.

preconditions: ReportGenerator has been initialized with valid ConfidenceDataSource, BudgetDataSource, and AuditDataSource instances.
config has been validated (all fields within declared ranges).
All injected data sources are available and responsive.
postconditions: Returned SystemReport has a unique report_id (UUID v4).
generated_at is set to the current UTC time at report creation.
task_confidence_reports contains exactly one entry per task type known to the ConfidenceDataSource.
task_types_count equals the length of task_confidence_reports.
Each CorrelationHistory has windows_requested equal to config.correlation_window_count.
Each CorrelationHistory has windows_available <= windows_requested.
cost_breakdown.budget_utilization_pct is consistent with total_remote_spend and budget_limit.
All datetime strings in the report are UTC ISO-8601 formatted.
All Decimal string fields are valid decimal representations.

structured_side_effects.description: Logs report generation start, data source query results, and completion with report_id.

performance_budget.complexity: O(T * W) where T = number of task types, W = correlation_window_count

functions.name: format_report
functions.description: Formats a SystemReport into a string representation using the specified ReportFormatter. JSON format produces a complete JSON serialization. CLI summary format produces a human-readable table with sections for confidence, costs, correlation, and alerts. This is a pure function with no side effects.

inputs.name: output_format
inputs.description: The desired output format (json or cli_summary).

error_cases.name: serialization_error
error_cases.condition: The SystemReport contains data that cannot be serialized into the requested format (e.g., non-UTF-8 characters, circular references).

preconditions: report is a valid, fully-populated SystemReport instance.
output_format is a recognized ReportFormat variant.
postconditions: Returned FormattedReport.report_id matches the input report.report_id.
Returned FormattedReport.format matches the requested output_format.
FormattedReport.content_length equals the length of FormattedReport.content.
If output_format is 'json', content is valid parseable JSON.
If output_format is 'cli_summary', content is a human-readable multi-line string with table formatting.
All Decimal string values in JSON output preserve full precision (not converted to float).

performance_budget.complexity: O(N) where N = total fields in the report

functions.name: deliver_webhook
functions.description: Delivers a SystemReport as JSON via HTTP POST to the configured webhook URL using an injected httpx.AsyncClient. Never raises an exception — all failures are captured in the returned DeliveryResult. Async function.

inputs.name: webhook_url
inputs.description: The URL to POST the JSON-serialized report to.

validators.error_message: Webhook URL must start with http:// or https://.

inputs.name: timeout_seconds
inputs.description: Timeout for the HTTP POST request in seconds.

validators.error_message: Timeout must be between 1 and 300 seconds.

error_cases.name: connection_refused
error_cases.condition: The webhook endpoint refuses the TCP connection.

error_data.detail: Connection refused by the target host.

error_cases.name: dns_resolution_failure
error_cases.condition: The webhook URL hostname cannot be resolved via DNS.

error_data.detail: DNS resolution failed for the webhook URL hostname.

error_cases.name: timeout_exceeded
error_cases.condition: The HTTP POST does not complete within timeout_seconds.

error_cases.name: non_2xx_response
error_cases.condition: The webhook endpoint responds with a non-2xx HTTP status code.

error_cases.name: tls_error
error_cases.condition: TLS handshake fails for an HTTPS webhook URL (certificate errors, protocol mismatch).

error_cases.name: serialization_failure
error_cases.condition: The SystemReport cannot be serialized to JSON for the POST body.

error_data.detail: Failed to serialize report to JSON.

preconditions: WebhookDelivery has been initialized with a valid httpx.AsyncClient instance.
report is a valid, fully-populated SystemReport instance.
webhook_url is a syntactically valid HTTP or HTTPS URL.
timeout_seconds is within the valid range.
postconditions: A DeliveryResult is always returned — this function never raises.
DeliveryResult.url matches the input webhook_url.
DeliveryResult.attempt_timestamp is set to the UTC time of the attempt.
DeliveryResult.duration_ms reflects actual elapsed time of the attempt.
If status is 'success', http_status_code is in [200, 299].
If status is 'failure', error_message is non-empty.
If status is 'timeout', error_message describes the timeout condition.
The POST body is the JSON-serialized SystemReport with Content-Type application/json.
side_effects: Sends an HTTP POST request to the configured webhook URL with the JSON-serialized report.

structured_side_effects.description: HTTP POST of JSON-serialized SystemReport to the configured webhook endpoint.
Logs delivery attempt, outcome status, HTTP status code, and duration.

functions.name: validate_report_config
functions.description: Validates a ReportConfig instance, ensuring all fields are within their declared constraints. Called at startup to fail fast on invalid configuration. Pure function.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: The report configuration to validate, typically parsed from YAML.

error_cases.name: invalid_webhook_url
error_cases.condition: webhook_url is non-empty but does not match a valid HTTP(S) URL pattern.

error_data.detail: Must be a valid http:// or https:// URL, or empty string.

preconditions: config is a ReportConfig instance (may have invalid field values).
postconditions: If no error is raised, the returned ReportConfig is valid and safe to use for report generation.
All field-level validators have passed.
If webhook_url is non-empty, it is a valid HTTP(S) URL.
Returned config is the same instance or an equivalent validated copy.

invariants: All SystemReport instances have a unique report_id (UUID v4) and a generated_at timestamp in UTC.
Report generation is read-only — it never mutates the state of any data source.
All Decimal/monetary values are represented as string-serialized Decimals, never floating point, to preserve precision.
All datetime values throughout the report hierarchy are UTC ISO-8601 formatted strings.
Formatting and delivery are separate steps from generation — generate() returns a pure data model, formatting and webhook delivery are independent operations.
Webhook delivery never raises exceptions — all failure modes are captured in a DeliveryResult object.
The number of TaskConfidenceReport entries in a SystemReport equals the number of task types known to the ConfidenceDataSource at generation time.
Each CorrelationHistory in the report has windows_available <= windows_requested.
Configuration is validated at startup (fail-fast) via validate_report_config; invalid config never reaches generate_report.
No global state — all state flows through explicit constructor parameters (data sources) and function arguments (config).
All public functions have full type annotations.
Files implementing this component must be under 300 lines each.
